note: Who owns every field on every official form in the Tranche 2 packet — all 56 fields of CC-DC-CR-148 and all 57 of MDJ-008, mapped or not. Tranche 1 filled documents LegalEase drafted, so a field existed only because someone chose to draw it. An official form is the opposite: the court decided what fields exist, and most of them belong to somebody other than the participant. This file is the record of that decision for each one, and the verifier reads it back against the source documents so a field cannot be added, renamed or silently mapped without the classification moving with it.
ownershipVocabulary: participant — the participant's own answer; LegalEase prints it
participant_manual — the participant's, but completed by hand after printing. LegalEase leaves a usable blank and never generates it
system_derived — determined by the packet's own identity rather than by any actor's answer, and approved for generation
prohibited_from_generation — LegalEase must never write here, whatever it knows
applicabilityVocabulary: in_scope — the field belongs to this packet
not_applicable — the field exists on the form for other filings and has no application to a Second Chance Act shielding petition. Unmapped for that reason, not because its owner is unknown
rules: Only `participant` and `system_derived` fields carry a mapping. Nothing else is writable by the renderer, because `acroMappingsFor` returns only the registered mappings and there is no mapping to write.
A `participant_manual` field is left blank on purpose and the packet's instructions name it. A blank signature line is the output, not a gap.
No signature image is generated for either form. Both signature lines and both signature dates come out of the renderer blank.

A field is never filled because the participant happens to know the answer. The attorney block is the clearest case: the participant knows their own lawyer's bar number, and it still stays blank, because entering an appearance is the lawyer's act.

`system_derived` is used only where the value follows from what the packet is. On MDJ-008 that is the two restricted-information boxes and the title of the submission: the confidential document this notice accompanies is always the shielding petition, so no participant answer can change it and asking would invite a wrong answer.
